usage: 返屋企 serves as a noun phrase meaning 'going home' or 'returning home'.
We can use 返屋企 to talk about the action of leaving work or school to go back home.
返屋企 can appear on its own or after verbs like '準備' (to prepare) or '想' (to want), e.g., 想返屋企 (want to go home).
It usually functions as an object or complement in a sentence, as in '我時間到可以返屋企' (When my time is up, I can go home).
Since it refers to the action of going home, 返屋企 can be used in daily life conversations about routines.
